crossRefs.note: “A son honors his father, and a servant his master. If I am a father, then where is my honor? And if I am a master…

Will a man rob God? Yet you rob me! But you say, ‘How have we robbed you?’ In tithes and offerings.
“So is the way of an adulterous woman: She eats and wipes her mouth, and says, ‘I have done nothing wrong.’
‘Why have we fasted,’ they say, ‘and you don’t see? Why have we afflicted our soul, and you don’t notice?’ “Behold, in…

I will come near to you to judgment; and I will be a swift witness against the sorcerers, and against the adulterers…

A loving doe and a graceful deer— let her breasts satisfy you at all times. Be captivated always with her love.

translations.web: Yet you say, ‘Why?’ Because Yahweh has been witness between you and the wife of your youth, against whom you have dealt treacherously, though she is your companion, and the wife of your covenant.
translations.bsb: Yet you ask, “Why?” It is because the LORD has been a witness between you and the wife of your youth, against whom you have broken faith, though she is your companion and your wife by covenant.
translations.kjv: Yet ye say, Wherefore? Because the LORD hath been witness between thee and the wife of thy youth, against whom thou hast dealt treacherously: yet is she thy companion, and the wife of thy covenant.
translations.asv: Yet ye say, Wherefore? Because Jehovah hath been witness between thee and the wife of thy youth, against whom thou hast dealt treacherously, though she is thy companion, and the wife of thy covenant.
